Lead 2026-10-04 (S2.5 review):
- Source verification fails closed. Unchecked, Checking and CheckFailed all block runs and design previews on that revision, with a reason naming the state. Only Present unblocks.
- Inputs are re-checked before every Save & run.
- The real backend (S3.7) re-verifies each source's digest at the point where it reads the bytes, so a file changed after the check can't be analysed.
- The design preview is blocked like a run. Its counts come from the sources, so a damaged source would show misleading numbers.
